title: A one-screen pajak STNK checklist
description: A one-screen pajak STNK checklist: start with the smallest version, know when to check it, and use a weekly review to keep your tax dates in view.
answer: On Friday your pajak STNK notes are a dozen half-finished lines with no comparable dates. GarageGo keeps pajak STNK on-device, so it stays readable with no data plan and no account.

sections.p: Three fields only: time, status, one blocker. Everything else is optional.
Open GarageGo at the same hour daily; do not wait for the right mood.
Once a week, look at the part that breaks most often and shrink the target instead of adding willpower.

table.caption: A working frame for pajak STNK

list: Pick one fixed time, not “whenever there is room”.
Open GarageGo when that time arrives, not later tonight.
Note one blocker, not a long excuse.
Back up before you switch phones.
faqs: Can I open pajak STNK offline?
Yes. GarageGo keeps everything on-device, so no data plan is needed.
Do I need an account first?
No. Start without login; export a backup from time to time.
With the shortest piece. Add scope only after two steady weeks.
What if I miss a few days?
Do not wipe history. Resume from the last entry and note one blocker.
